title: 117. How I Get the Most Out of Therapy + Feel Seen in Sessions - SOLO EP
description_html: Today's solo episode is all about optimizing your therapy appointments! I reflected on my 7 years of therapy and my experiences working with almost as many therapists to give you all my best tips to get the most out of your sessions! I talk about setting an agenda for your sessions, using a diary card, tracking your coping skills, celebrating your growth, setting tangible weekly goals (+ following up on them), getting support between appointments, navigating switching therapists, and challenging yourself to be vulnerable!
talk_about: setting an agenda for your sessions
mentioned_html:
+ Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT)

+ Bullet Journal Flip Through

+ Notion Habit Tracker

+ Habit Tracker App
summary: sadie shares seven years of therapy experience to help listeners optimize their sessions. she walks through practical strategies like preparing topics throughout the week, using diary cards or habit trackers to monitor emotions and skills, setting weekly goals with your therapist, asking for support between sessions, and challenging yourself to be vulnerable from the start. she emphasizes that dbt-informed therapy works best for her because it's concrete and skills-focused, and that real progress happens through consistent practice outside of sessions, not just the hour you spend talking.
quote: so much of therapy is not only what you bring to sessions, but what you implement outside of the session.
quote_display: so much of therapy is not only what you BRING to sessions, but what you IMPLEMENT OUTSIDE of the session.
